name: research_start
description:
Deep research / fast research: Search web or Google Drive to FIND NEW sources.

Use this for: "deep research on X", "find sources about Y", "search web for Z", "search Drive".
Workflow: research_start -> poll research_status -> research_import.

query.description: What to search for (e.g. "quantum computing advances")

mode.description: fast (~30s, ~10 sources) | deep (~5min, ~40 sources, web only)

notebook_id.description: Existing notebook (creates new if not provided)
